reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: To ensure provision of quality care and prevention services for all people in Kenya with TB, leprosy and lung diseases - Kenya (01-Jul-2021-30-Jun-2024)

description.narrative: Kenya, Tuberculosis, The National Treasury & Economic Planning of the Government of Kenya (TNT)This program has the following goals: Contribute to attainment of universal health coverage through comprehensive TB/HIV prevention, treatment and care for all people in kenya.. To ensure provision of quality care and prevention services for all people in Kenya with Tuberculosis.. To provide all Kenyans with 100% coverage on essential health services. The objectives of this program are: To build sustainable resilient systems for health and community, preparedness for emergency, pandemic, and response to in-country public health events to limit transmission, morbidity, and mortality by strengthening integrated disease surveillance and deployment of community-based surveillance systems.. To build a motivated, skilled, equitably distributed health and community workforce through capacity building, supportive supervision and deployment of digital tools and integrated health information system.. To improve the supply of quality medical oxygen through the procurement of bulk oxygen sources, oxygen distribution infrastructure and improved access of respiratory care and therapeutics. To strengthen laboratory systems at national and subnational levels for early detection and monitoring of disease outbreaks, identifying emerging pathogens, and informing public health decision-making by development and dissemination of guidelines, expanding integrated simple referral and multi-disease testing platforms.

title.narrative: Outcome indicators targets and results for KEN-T-TNTP05

National aggregate HMIS fully deployed and functional: Percentage of HMIS components in place (HIS deployment, completeness, timeliness, and integration of aggregate disease reporting for HIV, TB and malaria indicators)
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Percentage of health facilities with tracer medicines for the three diseases available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
Impact indicators targets and results for KEN-T-TNTP05
TB/HIV mortality rate per 100,000 population
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for KEN-T-TNTP05
Percentage of health product batches for the three diseases tested for quality in line with Global Fund Quality Assurance policy
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of notified TB cases (all forms) contributed by non-national TB program providers - community referrals
Percentage of TB patients with DST result for at least Rifampicin among the total number of notified (new and retreatment) cases in the same year
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid tests at the time of diagnosis
Number of TB cases (all forms) notified among prisoners
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Number of notified TB cases (all forms) contributed by non-national TB program providers - private/non-governmental facilities
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Percentage of public financial management system components used for grant financial management
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment

Percentage of laboratories showing adequate performance in external quality assurance for smear microscopy among the total number of laboratories that undertake smear microscopy during the reporting period
